## Install as an app

::: {.install-box}
Add this website to your phone or tablet so it opens like an app, with its own icon. Once it has been opened, it can also be read without an internet connection.

<button type="button" id="install-btn" class="translate-btn" hidden>Install the app</button>

**iPhone or iPad (Safari)**

1. Tap the Share button (the square with an arrow pointing up).
2. Scroll down and tap **Add to Home Screen**.
3. Tap **Add**.

**Android (Chrome)**

1. Tap the menu (three dots) at the top right.
2. Tap **Install app** or **Add to Home screen**.
3. Tap **Install**.

[Translation works best when you read the website in your browser rather than the installed app.]{.epub-note}
:::
